Update 10/4:

  • Amazon just dropped AirPods Pro 3 down to $179, delivering one of the lowest prices ever.
  • Amazon is also now delivering almost all M5 MacBook Air models at $200 off the list price.
  • You’ll find the very first cash discounts a wide range of Apple’s brand new TechWoven, Silicone, and Clear cases for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max from $41.50.
  • We’re also tracking the first discount on the latest refresh of Apple’s Magic Keyboard, down to $79.99 shipped.
  • Over at Best Buy, Powerbeats Pro 2 have dropped to match their all-time low at $179.99.

While we are still awaiting some of the big fall Prime Day deals on some Apple products, there are already notable discounts up for grabs right now like the $500 price drop on this 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, the new Beats 360 with 80% off the Cushion Kits, and Amazon low pricing on AirTag 2.

We are also already tracking the official fall Prime Day price drops on some of our favorite HomeKit smart home brands like ecobee and a sizable collection of Eve smart plugs, outlets, switches and more, not to mention new all-time lows on many of the latest Belkin 25W MagSafe charging stations. Just be sure to check out the popular new Twelve South Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay adapter at $40 on your way down.
